name: Endan Rekishi Emaki ~Nukata no Ookimi~
original_name: 艶談・歴史絵巻 ～ぬかたのおおきみ～
source:
Main character occasionally activates time machine and gets to 7th century Asuka period, the time of Taika reform establishment and Soga clan dominance.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/04/vn-of-year-1989.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公偶然启动时间机器，来到7世纪的飞鸟时代。当时大化改新刚刚开始，苏我氏仍把持着权势。

[引自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/04/vn-of-year-1989.html]vndbreview[/url]]
